text.en: Shoppers on Cathcart Road praise Odd Dogs for its thoughtfully curated collection of natural dog treats, nutritious food, durable toys, and accessories. Reviewers appreciate that the boutique focuses on wholesome and eco-friendly products rather than mass-market brands. Visitors note the shop is easy to browse, beautifully presented, and well stocked with canine essentials.

Pet owners warmly commend the staff for their friendly welcome and practical advice on pet nutrition and teething chews. Reviewers mention that team members take time to assist each customer, recommending suitable items for puppies and older dogs alike. Customers highlight the attentive customer service and genuine dedication shown to every visitor who walks in.

Dogs visiting the store receive an enthusiastic and caring welcome from the staff. Reviewers share that their pets love coming in for treats and cuddles, with staff members happy to interact with dogs and make them feel at ease. Pet parents appreciate that the boutique provides a calm and welcoming environment situated just a short walk from Queens Park.

q.en: Where is Odd Dogs located in Glasgow?

a.en: The store is located at 1067 Cathcart Road in Mount Florida, near Queens Park recreation ground.

q.en: What types of dog products does Odd Dogs stock?

a.en: The shop offers natural dog treats, nutritious foods, teething chews, eco-friendly toys, and durable accessories.

q.en: Are dogs allowed inside the shop?

a.en: Yes, pet owners frequently visit with their dogs and note that staff warmly welcome visiting pets.
